name: PCI-DSS Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

Pair with: the financial theme, which already resolves every cardholder-data rule in the catalog; this overlay is where PCI-specific handling of that data will land.

This overlay ships with no overrides yet. It exists so the regime has a stable, selectable identity in the wizard and in configuration summaries, and so the first override authored for it has a home that does not require a catalog restructure. Selecting it today activates the pci-dss profile — which the configuration's profile lens can filter rules by — and records the regime in the config's provenance; it does not change any rule's severity or effect.

Scope: PCI-DSS — regime identity, no overrides yet
